note: SIMULATED rehearsal parameters. Justifications in interface.md. Not live policy.

repair.D1: actor bound at boundary from trusted adapter context; any claim actor (incl record_terminal/atomic subevents) -> E_FORGED_ATTRIBUTION; untrusted contexts -> E_UNTRUSTED_ACTOR
repair.D2: start needs explicit duration_s/grant_ref (no fallback); every nested verify/handoff/hold deadline checked vs cap or phase-bound covering grant; actual phase from ledger (phase_hint rejected); 2099-without-grant rejected, pinned distant deadlines accepted
repair.D3: epoch = boot-counter + secrets token (unique per lifetime); backward UTC at reopen -> E_AMBIGUOUS_RESTART until bounded reconcile_clock; cross-process mono never compared; deadlines never extended

repair2: atomic disposition validated against post-verdict phase (pure-core simulation, read-only); both record_terminal and append(atomic=decide) stamp both subevents; invalid pairs rejected pre-write with no partial rows; standalone decide still gated
tolerance_justification: 120s bounds honest NTP offset (<1s typical) plus provisioning/delivery latency (seconds); the observed 32-minute future-dating exceeds it 16x. 60s wall-vs-monotonic divergence catches manual steps and large NTP corrections while tolerating drift and jitter.
